title: Persona 4 Revival Comes to Switch 2 on May 20, 2027 — Three Months After Other Platforms
description: Persona 4 Revival launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027, following the February 18 release on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Windows and Steam.
image_alt: Persona 4 Revival release-date artwork showing the May 20, 2027 Nintendo Switch 2 launch date.
quick_read: Persona 4 Revival launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027.
The PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Windows and Steam versions launch earlier on February 18, 2027.
The remake features enhanced graphics, UI, combat and cutscenes, plus quality-of-life improvements and added content.
SEGA lists physical editions for both PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.
